changes: Selected packages only; no system package replacements.
EasyTier stable 2.6.4 and Lucky 3.5.0 are official prebuilt x86_64 releases, downloaded through the build system with verified SHA256.
iStore UI source archive checksum pinned.
Keep the iStore page and its APIs under the canonical top-level admin/store path used by QuickStart.
Use normal conffiles handling; remove EasyTier temporary backup post-install routines and Lucky unnecessary package hooks.
Keep modern zh_Hans translations; omit legacy zh-cn directory symlink aliases.
Exclude README images and standalone install scripts from firmware source subtree.
EasyTier LuCI uses the official matching stable v2.6.4 source; missing core or invalid file configuration fails visibly instead of automatically fetching replacement executables.
EasyTier stays disabled and ships without a shared example network identity. Automatic network/firewall setup is disabled until explicitly selected.
Kucat registers its theme without overriding the firmware-selected active theme; duplicate registration removed.
Fix malformed upstream Kucat ACL JSON by removing an extra closing brace.
Do not log EasyTier connection arguments that may contain network credentials.
Lucky official release LICENSE is MIT; package also includes an Apache-2.0 process wrapper. Correct license metadata and install the upstream LICENSE.
Preserve TLS certificate verification in explicit EasyTier UI downloads and version checks.
Propagate the package manager exit status from iStore index updates for both APK and opkg instead of reporting failed updates as successful.
